content.title: Ansar Special Webinar:
content.subtitle: Productive Muslim: Why, What & How?
content.body:
Can Being Busy Really Make You Productive?

We spend our days juggling countless tasks, constantly moving from one responsibility to another. While trying to balance career, family, worship, physical well-being, and personal growth, we often assume that doing more will make us more productive.

But from an Islamic perspective, is productivity simply about accomplishing more in less time?

Or is true productivity rooted in purpose, balance, consistency, and Barakah?

A Special Webinar on Productivity

To explore these questions, Muslims Day is hosting an Ansar Special Webinar: “Productive Muslim: Why, What & How?”

The session will be led by Shahriar Khan, an EMCC-recognized Senior Practitioner Coach and Certified Productive Muslim Trainer, with more than 20 years of international training and coaching experience.

What Will You Learn?

The session will explore productivity from an Islamic perspective, Barakah Culture vs. Hustle Culture, and how our Nafs, spirituality, well-being, focus, and time management influence productivity.

You will also learn why we often struggle to remain consistent even after starting something good, and how practical habits and effective systems can help us become better versions of ourselves without relying solely on willpower.

How to Join

  1. If you are a Muslims Day Ansar: As an Ansar member, you can join the session live on Zoom and take part in an exclusive Q&A session with the speaker. To participate, please complete your registration. The registration form link has been sent to you via email. If you have not received the link for any reason, please contact our Customer Support team. We will provide you with the registration link, InshaAllah.

  2. Not an Ansar member? No worries. The session will be broadcast live on the Muslims Day Facebook Page, InshaAllah. This means the valuable discussion will remain open and accessible to everyone.

So, amid the busyness of life, let us focus not simply on doing more, but on building a life that is more meaningful, balanced, and filled with Barakah. Stay connected with us and be part of the session.
